The '''renewable shield''' was a [[droid shield]] that could be maintained and renewed without the replacement of the unit. This ambient-energy collection system allowed this shield to be raised and lowered a near infinite amount of times.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[T3-M4]] is able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
